predecessors.name: Kingdom of Naples (Bourbon)
predecessors.text: the former kingdom's mainland territory, which the republic 'divided ... into departments'

successors.name: Kingdom of Naples (Bourbon)
successors.text: the mainland, retaken by Ruffo's Sanfedists (Naples on 13 June 1799; Pescara, the last stronghold, on 30 June); Ferdinand re-entered the Bay of Naples on 10 July 1799

ledger.x: 21-23 January 1799: the Parthenopean Republic is proclaimed at Naples.
13 June 1799: the Parthenopean Republic ends after about five months.

wars.name: Sanfedist reconquest of the Kingdom of Naples
wars.outcome: Cardinal Ruffo raised a 'Christian army' in Calabria, reached Naples on 13 June 1799 and ended the republic; Pescara fell on 30 June; Ferdinand returned on 10 July 1799.

certainty.note: The republic's real authority outside Naples and Abruzzo (the places the page names) is not given by the page; Calabria was a royalist base.
